result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the main LOC of the repositories with commits in the past 90 days. I haven't compiled it or run any tests, since it's a one-word change.

The block was printing `loc180Days` as its LOC figure, while its percentage already used `loc90Days`. I changed it to `loc90Days` in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`. Your example should now give 2.5K LOC for "past 180d" and 500 LOC for "past 90d".
